title: Binary expansion after multiplication by a power of two
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $p$ with $C\ne 0$, the binary expansion of $C\cdot 2^p$ is the list of $p$ zero bits followed by the binary expansion of $C$.
replaced: For natural numbers $C \ne 0$ and $p$, the little-endian binary expansion of $C \cdot 2^p$ equals $p$ zero bits followed by the binary expansion of $C$.
